bio.text: Shannon Bray is the Libertarian Party candidate for U.S. Senate in North Carolina in the November 3, 2026 election.
He was born in Marrero, Louisiana, and served in the U.S. Navy from 1991 to 1997.

He earned degrees from Arapahoe Community College (2014), Colorado State University (2016) and the University of Delaware (2018), and has worked in information technology, software development and information security.
